Method of Attack: Rowhammer-based attack exploiting bit flipping in RAM to read secret data without accessing it
Cross address space attack using attacker-controlled row activation pages to induce bit flips
Frame Feng Shui method to place secret data pages in attacker-chosen physical memory frames
Use of Heninger-Shacham algorithm to recover RSA keys from partial information
Impacted Systems: Potentially DDR4 RAM systems vulnerable to Rowhammer-induced bit flips
Attack Vector: Repeated memory access (hammering) to induce bit flips in adjacent memory rows
Exploitation of ECC memory bit flipping to read secret data
Indicators of Compromise: RSA-2048 key leakage from OpenSSH 7.9 server
Tested on HP Prodesk 600 with i5-4570 CPU and Axiom DDR3 4 GiB 1333 MHz non-ECC DIMMs (51264Y3D3N13811)
